answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Reaching the ripple of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A horizon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quartz of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
